steps.js: (() => { const row=[...document.querySelectorAll('.search-panel button.search-panel__row')].find(e=>e.textContent.includes('e2e-test-project')); if(!row) return 'row-not-found'; const r=row.getBoundingClientRect(); const cx=Math.round(r.x+r.width/2), cy=Math.round(r.y+r.height/2); const hit=document.elementFromPoint(cx,cy); return JSON.stringify({center:{cx,cy}, hitTag:hit?hit.tagName:null, hitClass:hit?(hit.className||'').toString().slice(0,60):null, hitText:hit?(hit.textContent||'').slice(0,30):null, hitIsRowOrChild: hit? row.contains(hit):null, dlgOpen:!!document.querySelector('.search-panel')}); })()
